name: Lateral Jump
instructions: Stand on one foot next to a line or marker with a slight knee bend.
Jump sideways off that foot to the other side.
Land softly on the opposite foot and stick the landing.
Immediately jump back to the other side.
Keep your hips and knees aligned.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: A side-to-side plyometric jump that trains lateral power and landing control.
